 Sadie Stanley & Julian Grey Will Co-Star in Netflix’s ‘Twilight: Midnight Sun’ Series (EXCLUSIVE)
 Sadie Stanley and Julian Grey have joined the voice cast of the upcoming Netflix animated series, Twilight: Midnight Sun, as Bella Swan and Edward Cullen. 
 Exclusive , News November 6, 2026 11:00 am November 6, 2026 11:52 am Caleb Williams 
 Stay connected via Google News 
 Follow us for the latest movie and TV news updates. 
 Today, we at Knight Edge Media have exclusively learned that actors Sadie Stanley and Julian Grey have joined the voice cast of the upcoming Netflix animated series, Twilight: Midnight Sun . The duo was cast earlier this year as Bella Swan and Edward Cullen for the highly anticipated animated series. Kristen Stewart and Robert Pattinson made the roles famous in the early 2000s. Stanley is best known for appearing in 2025’s Karate Kid: Legends and a Kim Possible live-action TV movie for Disney. While, Grey appeared in the AMC series Fear the Walking Dead in 2023.
 We revealed several months ago that the streaming series was just beginning casting for the supporting role of Jacob Black (previously played by Taylor Lautner ). It’s currently unknown who has been cast. The series is expected to tell Twilight’s story from Edward’s perspective rather than Bella’s. The series currently has a two-season commitment, according to Whats-on-Netflix . Original author Stephenie Meyer will executive produce. Sinead Daly (The Get Down, Reservation Road) is serving as showrunner, with Lynn Wang on board as supervising director.
 Netflix could not comment on the story at this time.
 Twilight: Midnight Sun has no set release date 
 Key Takeaways 
 − 
 Sadie Stanley and Julian Grey will star as Bella Swan and Edward Cullen in Netflix's upcoming series.
 The animated project will adapt Stephenie Meyer 's story to focus specifically on Edward's perspective instead of Bella's .
 The streaming show has secured a two-season commitment with Sinead Daly serving as showrunner.
